wc:minerva-segmented-control.summary: Single-choice segmented switch with a sliding thumb.
wc:minerva-segmented-control.description: A single-choice segmented switch for modes and filters (`<SegmentedControl>` of React): a `radiogroup` of `radio` segments sharing the width equally, with a thumb sliding under the selected segment. Use `<minerva-tabs>` when each choice has a content panel. Keyboard: one Tab stop (the selected segment, else the first enabled one); the arrow keys move and select, skipping disabled segments and wrapping (RTL-aware); Home / End select the first / last enabled segment. Form-associated: submits `value` under `name`, `required` makes it invalid while nothing is selected, and it supports `form.reset()` (restores the `value` attribute), `<fieldset disabled>` and state restoration. Name it with `aria-label`, `aria-labelledby` or `<label for>`.

properties.description: Whether the control is disabled (itself or by a disabled fieldset).

examples.title: Basic usage
examples.description: options is a JSON array (or comma-separated values) attribute or a property; value sets the initial selection and minerva-change reports the selected value. One tab stop: the arrow keys move and select.

examples.title: Colors and disabled
examples.description: color="primary" shows a solid primary thumb; disabled options and the disabled attribute block selection.

files.apps/docs/src/docs/pages/segmented-contr:
<form id="billing-form" style="display: grid; gap: 12px; max-width: 420px">
  <minerva-segmented-control
    full-width
    name="billing"
    aria-label="Billing period"
    options='[{"value":"monthly","label":"Monthly"},{"value":"yearly","label":"Yearly (−20%)"}]'
    value="yearly"
  ></minerva-segmented-control>
  <minerva-segmented-control
    full-width
    aria-label="Status filter"
    options="all,open,closed,archived"
    value="all"
  ></minerva-segmented-control>
</form>

examples.title: Full width and forms
examples.description: full-width stretches the control; it is form-associated, so name submits the value, required validates it and form.reset() restores the value attribute.

examples.title: Icons
examples.description: Option objects take an icon (text, a Node or a lit template through the property) and an aria-label for icon-only segments.

translationResources.title: SegmentedControl
translationResources.description: A single-choice segmented switch for modes and filters, with a thumb sliding under the selected segment. Use Tabs when each choice has its own content panel.

basic.title: Basic usage
basic.description: A controlled value (value / onChange; the value type is generic). The control is a radiogroup of radio segments with one tab stop: the arrow keys move and select (skipping disabled segments, wrapping around), Home / End jump to the ends.

icons.title: Icons
icons.description: Options can carry an icon next to their label, or an icon alone; icon-only segments need an aria-label.

sizes.title: Sizes
sizes.description: Three densities following the control heights. Plain strings are both the value and the label.

full-width.title: Full width
full-width.description: fullWidth stretches the control over its container; the segments always share the width equally. name adds a hidden input so the value is submitted with a form.

colors.title: Colors and disabled
colors.description: neutral (default) shows a raised thumb on a muted track, primary a solid primary thumb. Disable single segments or the whole control.

SegmentedControlProps.name: Name of a hidden input carrying the value in a form
SegmentedControlProps.aria-labelledby: Id of the element labelling the group

SegmentedControlOptionObject.label: Visible label (defaults to the value, unless an icon is given)
SegmentedControlOptionObject.icon: Icon shown before the label (alone for an icon-only segment)
SegmentedControlOptionObject.aria-label: Accessible name; required for an icon-only segment
